thread.title: Microsoft Passes Google Parent Alphabet In Market Value

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Microsoft Passes Google Parent Alphabet In Market Value
text:
Software leader Microsoft ( MSFT ) surpassed Google parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ) in market value on Tuesday, making it the world's third most valuable publicly traded company, behind Apple ( AAPL ) and Amazon ( AMZN ).
X Microsoft had a market capitalization of $753 billion at the close of trading on the stock market today . That compares with about $739 billion for Alphabet.
The position change comes six years after Google surpassed Microsoft in valuation, CNBC reported .
Apple Leads Apple leads all comers with a market cap of nearly $924 billion. Some Wall Street analysts believe Apple could become the first company to top $1 trillion in value this year. Amazon is a distant second, with a value of nearly $783 billion.
 Microsoft's recent stock appreciation comes as the company continues its shift to a cloud-computing business model. The Redmond, Wash.-based company built its fortunes on selling Windows and Office software for PCs. Now it is focused on selling subscription software (such as Office 365, Azure and Dynamics 365) through the internet cloud.
In March, Microsoft Chief Executive Satya Nadella reorganized the company to provide a greater emphasis on cloud computing and artificial intelligence.
